summary: Frontend-only validation of GMC Refinement Round (P0 mobile + P1 desktop + P2 polish). Ran Playwright suite covering 35+ checks across mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900) viewports. 100% of user-visible acceptance criteria pass. No backend testing performed (per request — static app).
critical_code_review_comments: MobileSheet StrictMode double-popstate guard (150ms) is a pragmatic fix; consider replacing with an explicit isPushed ref to avoid time-based heuristics in dev mode.

ComparisonTable.jsx is ~450 lines and mixes desktop grid + mobile stacked cards + empty state — consider extracting DesktopGrid / MobileStack subcomponents for maintainability (>700 line rule not breached yet, but approaching).

In MobileSheet the cleanup effect calls window.history.back() unconditionally when historyPushedRef is true — this is correct but slightly coupled to a global; document that only one MobileSheet should ever be open at a time.

ControlDock: the .gmc-toggle class-based diff toggle inside dock-filter-popover is reachable only when popover is open. Confirmed working; no issue but keep behaviour when popover closes on outside interaction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a fully static React app (no backend). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is used as the site URL only. Landing route (/) is the compare page. Use viewport 390x844 for mobile and 1440x900 for desktop. Data-testids used: detail-sheet[-close|-backdrop|-panel|-body], ask-sheet[-close], mbb-compare-sheet[-close], mobile-bottom-bar, mbb-{compare,ask,adviser,sheet-done,diff-toggle}, control-dock, dock-{insurers,filter,ask,share,picker-popover,filter-popover,diff-toggle,chip-*}, filter-all, filter-group-*, insurer-*, comparison-empty[-clear], comparison-table, glance-card-*, ask-panel-input, ask-compact-input, ask-panel-desktop. Note: matchMedia updates require setting viewport BEFORE goto — reload if you resize. First glance-card click after page load can be flaky if hydration/scroll haven't settled; use scroll_into_view_if_needed + 300-500ms wait before clicking.
